sentences.text: In short: OSLO SYD TRAFIKKSKOLE HOLMLIA AS is an established micro company in "undervisning ved godkjente trafikkskoler" based in Oslo, profitable in 2025 and with no open NAV job ads under its org number.

OSLO SYD TRAFIKKSKOLE HOLMLIA AS is registered in the industry "Undervisning ved godkjente trafikkskoler"; its registered activity is "Trafikkopplæring. Trafikalt grunnkurs, kjøretimer, førerprøver, teorikurs og veiledning innenfor det trafikale.".
OSLO SYD TRAFIKKSKOLE HOLMLIA AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2018-06-28, registered in Oslo.
It has 8 registered employees, reported revenue of NOK 13.06M for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 1.05M (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 8.0% and a moderate equity ratio of 30% of total assets.

Revenue rose 73.6% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 7.52M to NOK 13.06M); it was NOK 7.45M in 2023. The annual result went from a loss in 2024 to a profit in 2025 (2023: NOK 608,670, 2024: -NOK 269,040, 2025: NOK 675,545).
OSLO SYD TRAFIKKSKOLE HOLMLIA AS is led by Shoaib Ul-Hassan, who is both CEO and board chair.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2025-03-20.
OSLO SYD TRAFIKKSKOLE HOLMLIA AS has 1 registered workplace.
